definitions.explanation: Something used to conceal one's true activities or intentions. From a magical straw raincoat in folklore that made its wearer invisible.

examples.japanese: その{会社|かいしゃ}は{犯罪|はんざい}の{隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}だった。
examples.english: That company was a front for crime.

examples.japanese: ボランティア{活動|かつどう}を{隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}にして{金|かね}を{集|あつ}めていた。
examples.english: They used volunteer work as a cover to collect money.

examples.japanese: {慈善|じぜん}{団体|だんたい}という{隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}の{下|した}で{脱税|だつぜい}が{行|おこな}われていた。
examples.english: Tax evasion was carried out under the guise of a charity organization.

notes:
Literally a {蓑|みの} (straw raincoat) that makes its wearer invisible, from Japanese folklore. Figuratively, anything used to hide one's real purpose or wrongdoing.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- 〜を{隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}にする: to use ~ as a cover
- {隠|かく}れ{蓑|みの}の{下|した}で: under the guise of

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {口実|こうじつ}: pretext; excuse — a verbal justification rather than a concealing front
- {偽装|ぎそう}: disguise; camouflage — the act of faking an appearance
